dXPqHYtwQIWPpv5ovAiLZQ.zh: 捷克今年9月通報1例48歲男性確定病例,因頭部撕裂傷接受治療,為自2022年來首例,該國近20年僅報告5例。
dXPqHYtwQIWPpv5ovAiLZQ.en: The Czech Republic reported one confirmed case in September this year, in a 48-year-old man being treated for a scalp laceration. This is the first case since 2022, and the country has reported only 5 cases in nearly 20 years.

_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,多國自去(2025)年12月截至今年5月中旬累計報告至少83例病例,其中至少20例住院,病患以兒童及年輕人為多,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疫情分布於丹麥、匈牙利、捷克、法國等9個歐洲國家,經調查疑感染源為雞肉相關產品,受影響國家已要求廠商將相關產品下架。
5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.en: European outbreak update: between December 2025 and mid-May 2026, multiple countries reported at least 83 cases, of which at least 20 were hospitalised. Cases are mainly among children and young people. Genotyping identified Salmonella Stanley ST2045. The outbreak is spread across nine European countries, including Denmark, Hungary, Czechia and France. Investigations suggest the suspected source is chicken-related products, and affected countries have asked manufacturers to withdraw the products from the market.

dtrIeE23HNOzrJN_nanOXg.zh: 捷克 2025 年侵入性腦膜炎球菌疾病(IMD)疫情上升,2025 年報告 23 例病例,高於 2024 年(15 例),血清群分布以 B 型占比較高,且 0-11 個月大年齡族群之發生率亦明顯上升。
dtrIeE23HNOzrJN_nanOXg.en: Invasive meningococcal disease (IMD) in Czechia increased in 2025, with 23 cases reported in 2025, higher than 15 in 2024. Serogroup B accounted for a higher share, and incidence in infants aged 0–11 months also rose markedly.

VfeRn8w80o6BRXzERYXXyw.zh: 捷克今年截至3/1累計報告643例病例,其中59%為男性,病患分布以南模拉維亞(South Moravian)地區為多;另該國2025年累計報告逾3,000例病例,其中40例死亡,為1980年代以來最嚴峻之疫情,當局評估今年疫情將逐步趨緩。
VfeRn8w80o6BRXzERYXXyw.en: Czechia reported 643 cases cumulatively this year through 1 March, of which 59% were men. Cases are mainly distributed in the South Moravian Region. The country reported more than 3,000 cases in 2025, of which 40 died, the most severe outbreak since the 1980s. Authorities assess that the outbreak will gradually ease this year.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.zh: 中歐多國爆發疫情,其中奧地利、捷克、匈牙利、斯洛維亞今年截至10月累計報告逾6,000例病例,其中41-80%住院,病患多為街友或毒品使用者等脆弱族群,病毒型別涵蓋兩組相近的IB型,此波疫情遠高於去年,並已擴及9個歐洲國家,另迄未發現食源性傳播跡象。
_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.en: Several Central European countries have experienced outbreaks. Austria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovenia reported more than 6,000 cases cumulatively as of October this year, of which 41–80% were hospitalised. Most patients belong to vulnerable groups, such as homeless people or people who use drugs. The virus types include two closely related genotype IB clusters. This outbreak is far higher than last year's and has spread to 9 European countries. No evidence of foodborne transmission has been found so far.

Ku5EP_BIEJ-pK72fT3171w.zh: 捷克疫情更新,今年截至10/22累計報告2,141例病例,其中26例死亡,疫情為1989年以來第2高,並以布拉最為嚴峻;當局已擴大疫苗接種措施,並調整布拉地鐵車門為自動開啟,以降低民眾接觸之染疫風險。
Ku5EP_BIEJ-pK72fT3171w.en: Czechia update: As of 22 October this year, 2,141 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 26 deaths. The outbreak is the second-highest since 1989 and is most severe in Prague. Authorities have expanded vaccination measures and set Prague metro doors to open automatically to reduce the risk of infection from public contact.

-mgjLzC6ZcSuM__2jCNSNQ.zh: 捷克首都布拉疫情嚴峻,今年截至11/3累計報告939例病例,約佔該國所有感染病例之40%,病例數為去年(37例)25倍,其中11例死亡,尤以弱勢族群之傳播風險為高;當局表示該國民眾疫苗接種人次為去年2倍,並持續因應疫情調整接種措施。
-mgjLzC6ZcSuM__2jCNSNQ.en: The Czech capital, Prague, has a severe outbreak: as of 3 November this year, 939 cases had been reported cumulatively, about 40% of all cases in the country and 25 times last year's total of 37 cases, including 11 deaths. The transmission risk is especially high among vulnerable groups. Authorities say the number of vaccine doses administered in the country this year is twice last year's, and they continue to adjust vaccination measures in response to the outbreak.

x7k0QwuNu_td6UL2Ww9vWg.zh: 捷克布拉今年截至10/15累計報告826例病例,其中10例死亡;另該國今年截至9月累計報告逾1,500例病例,為去年同期4倍,且為1989年以來第2嚴重之疫情。
x7k0QwuNu_td6UL2Ww9vWg.en: Prague, Czechia: As of 15 October this year, 826 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 10 deaths. Separately, the country had reported more than 1,500 cases cumulatively as of September this year, four times the same period last year, making it the second most severe outbreak since 1989.

zlyYryvX0D60ubeBstI-GQ.zh: 捷克首都布拉疫情嚴峻,今年截至9/6累計報告505例,病例數為去年2倍,為自2008年以來最嚴重疫情;當局已加強疫苗接種,並加強環境清潔衛生。另該國今年迄今累計報告逾1,300例病例,其中,15例死亡。
zlyYryvX0D60ubeBstI-GQ.en: Prague, the capital of Czechia, is experiencing a severe outbreak: as of 6 September this year, 505 cases had been cumulatively reported, twice last year's number and the most serious outbreak since 2008. Authorities have stepped up vaccination and strengthened environmental cleaning and hygiene. The country has also reported more than 1,300 cases cumulatively this year, including 15 deaths.

kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.zh: 中歐國家疫情升高,今年截至6月累計報告逾2,000例,9例死亡,其中斯洛伐克880例、捷克600例、匈牙利530例、奧地利87例,德國3起個案與匈牙利病例基因序列一致,顯示疾病跨域傳播,惟未發現疫情蔓延。ECDC表示此波疫情流行主要為IB型之2個基因群組,影響包括遊民、吸毒者及居住不良衛生環境族群,評估大於40歲為高風險族群,呼籲加強疫苗接種及衛生措施。 中國今年截至6月累計報告逾1.1萬例病例,高於去年同期(7,500例)。
kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.en: Hepatitis A is rising in Central European countries. As of June this year, more than 2,000 cases and 9 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Slovakia 880, Czech Republic 600, Hungary 530 and Austria 87. Three cases in Germany have genetic sequences identical to Hungarian cases, indicating cross-border transmission, although no wider spread has been detected. The ECDC says this wave is mainly caused by two genogroups of genotype IB, affecting homeless people, people who use drugs, and people living in poor sanitary conditions. People over 40 are assessed as high-risk, and the ECDC calls for stronger vaccination and hygiene measures. China has reported more than 11,000 cases as of June this year, higher than the 7,500 cases in the same period last year.

56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.zh: 德國巴伐利亞邦爆發疫情,共報告18例,病例皆與當地5月初舉行之國際活動相關,其中12例為來自波蘭/義大利/捷克/英國之民眾;玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省報告7例,指標病例為22歲男性,具傳染力期間曾參加大型宗教集會,因具社區傳播風險,當局發布衛生警示。隨北半球夏季即將到來,預期旅遊及大型活動增加,將提升疾病傳播及跨境感染風險。 美國亞利桑納州報告該州今年首起疫情,4例病患來自該州東部納瓦荷郡,皆未接種疫苗,近期有境外旅遊史,均來自同一感染源;該國截至6/5共34州報告17起疫情,累計1,168例病例,其中137例住院及3例死亡。
56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.en: An outbreak in Bavaria, Germany, has reported 18 cases, all linked to an international event held locally in early May; 12 of the cases were people from Poland, Italy, the Czech Republic and the United Kingdom. In Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia, 7 cases have been reported. The index case was a 22-year-old man who attended a large religious gathering during his infectious period. Because of the risk of community transmission, authorities have issued a health alert. As the northern hemisphere summer approaches, travel and large events are expected to increase, raising the risk of disease spread and cross-border infection. In the United States, Arizona reported the state's first outbreak this year: 4 patients from Navajo County in the east of the state, all unvaccinated, with recent overseas travel, all from the same source. As of 5 June, 34 states have reported 17 outbreaks in the country, with 1,168 cumulative cases, including 137 hospitalized and 3 deaths.

6gsNm_kUnM9PubKJpv2ddw.zh: 捷克5/16報告1例病例,疑伊波拉病毒感染症/馬堡病毒出血熱,病患為41歲美國籍男性個案,近期自剛果民主共和國經盧安達及美國,於5/6抵達捷克,原於該國南部塔博爾就診,後於5/16出現出血熱症狀,轉診至北部布拉醫院隔離,已排除瘧疾,當局匡列26名接觸者進行隔離,餘檢驗結果待公布。
6gsNm_kUnM9PubKJpv2ddw.en: Czechia reported one case on 16 May, suspected to be Ebola virus disease or Marburg haemorrhagic fever. The patient is a 41-year-old US national who recently travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Rwanda and the United States, arriving in Czechia on 6 May. He first received care in Tábor in the south of the country, and on 16 May developed haemorrhagic fever symptoms and was transferred to a hospital in Prague for isolation. Malaria has been ruled out. Authorities have identified 26 contacts and placed them in quarantine; other test results are pending.

F5S4u98DZhMMU02mC5mI3g.zh: 捷克疫情持續嚴峻,每週新增400餘例病例,今年截至12/1累計報告36,149例,其中2.4%住院,12例死亡,以15至19歲年齡族群發病率最高。 芬蘭今年4月起疫情驟升,截至10月累計報告2,215例病例,為近30年最高,病患以10-19歲青少年最多,並有22例不足3個月齡(未接種疫苗)病例,當局表示將加強孕婦疫苗接種;另法國及芬蘭均已發現抗藥性菌株,對嬰兒之治療影響重大,專家呼籲需加強抗藥性菌株診斷能力。
F5S4u98DZhMMU02mC5mI3g.en: Czech Republic: The outbreak remains severe, with over 400 new cases weekly. As of 1 December this year, 36,149 cases had been reported cumulatively, 2.4% of them hospitalised, and 12 deaths; incidence is highest in the 15–19-year-old age group. Finland: The outbreak has surged since April this year. As of October, 2,215 cases had been reported cumulatively, the highest in nearly 30 years. Patients are mostly aged 10–19 years, and there were 22 cases in infants under three months old (unvaccinated); authorities say they will strengthen vaccination of pregnant women. In addition, France and Finland have both detected antibiotic-resistant strains, which have a major impact on the treatment of infants; experts call for stronger diagnostic capacity for resistant strains.

Rxd5WcJBhWoNOOdxOVSlFA.zh: 美國疫情上升,第43週單週新增462例,明顯較前2週之246、348例為高,今年截至10/26累計報告20,824例病例,為去年同期之4.5倍,其中以賓州、威斯康辛州、伊利諾州、紐約州及加州等地最為嚴峻。 南太平洋法屬波里西亞疫情上升,10月下旬單週新增30餘例病例,自6月爆發疫情迄今累計報告191例,其中10例兒童住院治療;新喀里多亞今年截至10月中旬累計報告79例病例,其中44%為14歲以下兒童,分布以南部省佔近6成最多。 捷克疫情持續嚴峻,今年截至11/3累計報告34,423例病例,其中2.4%住院,12例死亡,以15至19歲年齡層發病率最高,分布以該國東北部摩拉維亞-西利西亞州4,125例最多。
Rxd5WcJBhWoNOOdxOVSlFA.en:
United States: Pertussis is rising. Weekly new cases reached 462 in week 43, clearly higher than the 246 and 348 in the previous two weeks. As of 26 October this year, 20,824 cases have been cumulatively reported, 4.5 times the same period last year. The most severely affected areas include Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Illinois, New York State and California.

French Polynesia in the South Pacific: Cases are rising. Weekly new cases exceeded 30 in late October. Since the outbreak began in June, 191 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 10 children hospitalized for treatment. New Caledonia: As of mid-October this year, 79 cases have been cumulatively reported, 44% of whom are children under 14. Cases are concentrated in the Southern Province, which accounts for nearly 60%.

Czechia: The outbreak remains severe. As of 3 November this year, 34,423 cases have been cumulatively reported, 2.4% of whom were hospitalized, with 12 deaths. The highest incidence is in the 15–19 age group. Most cases are in the Moravian-Silesian Region in the northeast, with 4,125 cases.

JbW5N2XCumpQIBrbv9_a1g.zh: 泰國今年截至10/8累計報告2,926例病例,以45至64歲族群為多,其中29例死亡,多為農民。 印度喀拉拉邦今年截至10/4累計報告約4,500例病例,其中2,512例確診,確診病例中155例死亡(CFR:6.2%)。 捷克9/29報告今年首例病例,為東部摩拉維亞-西利西亞州64歲男性,於9月中旬遭遇洪災,直接暴露於受汙染水源。
JbW5N2XCumpQIBrbv9_a1g.en: Thailand has reported 2,926 cases cumulatively this year as of 8 October, mainly among people aged 45 to 64; 29 died, most of them farmers. India's Kerala state reported about 4,500 cases cumulatively this year as of 4 October, of which 2,512 were confirmed; 155 of the confirmed cases died (CFR: 6.2%). Czechia reported its first case of this year on 29 September: a man aged 64 from the Moravian-Silesian Region in the east, who was directly exposed to contaminated water after floods in mid-September.
